scope: Real Chromium mobile emulation, actual WebGL2 software rendering and actual touch input/Rapier. Simulation stepped by test timer independently of expensive render readbacks. Performance graphics preset (about 0.52MP) explicitly selected. Not real-time/FPS/physical-phone evidence.
